## Definition of done (docs/process.md §5)

- [ ] Every acceptance criterion is checked, or moved to another card with its ID
- [ ] Tests cover the rules and criteria (docs/testing.md §2); `run-checks.mjs` passes
- [ ] Docs that describe the change are updated
- [ ] Review findings triaged and the accepted ones fixed
- [ ] The card's `[done]` log line says what, where and how to test
- [ ] The supervisor approved the card
